notablePrerequisites:
You control at least six creatures.
An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner or Aetherwind Basker.
Aetherwind Basker does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Lightning Runner and Aetherwind Basker as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Aetherwind Basker trigger, causing you to get at least six {E}.
Resolve the Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}, and then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
If you control more than six creatures, this combo will net infinite {E}.
